attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: website_content_ingestion_pipeline
steps:
  - id: authenticate_admin
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "club_administrator"
    output: auth_result

  - id: fetch_sitemap
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/sitemap.xml"
      format: "xml"
    output: raw_sitemap

  - id: validate_sitemap
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_sitemap
      schema: sitemap_xml_schema
    output: validated_sitemap

  - id: extract_urls
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_sitemap
      mapping: "parse_xml_extract_urls"
      description: "Parse XML sitemap and extract all page URLs into a list"
    output: url_list

  - id: loop_url_batches
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: url_list
      batch_size: 10
      iterate_step: process_batch
    output: batch_results

  - id: process_batch
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: process_page_batch
      input: current_batch
    output: batch_output

  - id: wait_between_batches
    op: wait_for_condition
    params:
      condition: "delay_seconds"
      delay_seconds: 5
      description: "Wait 5 seconds between batches to rate limit"

  - id: handle_batch_errors
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: process_batch
      action: skip
      description: "Skip pages that return errors without halting pipeline"

  - id: fetch_page_content
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "{{current_url}}"
      format: "html"
    output: raw_page_html

  - id: handle_fetch_errors
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: fetch_page_content
      action: skip
      description: "Skip individual pages that fail to fetch"

  - id: extract_main_content
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: raw_page_html
      field: ".main_content"
      selector_type: "css"
    output: extracted_content

  - id: validate_extracted_content
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: extracted_content
      schema: page_content_schema
    output: validated_content

  - id: transform_for_vector_store
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_content
      mapping:
        content: "{{validated_content.text}}"
        source_url: "{{current_url}}"
        namespace: "knowledge_base"
        generate_embeddings: true
    output: vector_payload

  - id: send_to_vector_store
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: vector_payload
      url: "https://vectorstore.internal/api/upsert"
      method: "POST"
      namespace: "knowledge_base"
    output: vector_store_response

  - id: log_ingestion_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: vector_store_response
      action: "knowledge_base_refresh"
      description: "Content ingestion completed for club website"
    output: audit_entry

  - id: notify_admin
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: audit_entry
      recipient: "club_administrator"
      channel: "email"
      message: "Knowledge base refresh completed successfully."
    output: notification_result

  - id: terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      summary: "Website content ingestion pipeline finished"
